about: every cel cut of the WYGWYL suite (cels/build_celcuts.py)

chapters.title: How To Break Off An Engagement

cuts.title: Cels
cuts.idea: The film redrawn as cartoon cels: each poem carved into 6–12 s patches on his reading, each patch one moving shot, redrawn every 3 s from the drawing before, EbSynth between.

cuts.title: Spine-Cut Cels
cuts.idea: Spine-Cut’s reviewed picks redrawn as cartoon cels: every spine section plays the archive shot its editor chose for the line, redrawn every 3 s from the drawing before, EbSynth between.

cuts.title: Cels, first way
cuts.idea: The same patches as Cels, drawn the first way: every keyframe drawn from scratch every second, the frames between blended along the footage’s motion. Kept to compare.

measures.pops_per_s: drawings that jump: sudden changes per second the footage does not explain (lower is steadier)
measures.ghost: double images between drawings (lower is cleaner)
measures.track: how well the drawing follows the footage’s motion (1 = exactly)
measures.dE: colour error of each drawing against its frame (lower is closer)
measures.cost: seconds of compute per second of film
